topic: DC power supply systems, rectified power supplies
syllabus_extract: DC power supply systems, rectified power supplies.
specific_objectives: 13.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the A/C power systems.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of schematic diagrams; Instructor supervision of Q&A session
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a DC power supply?
How does an aircraft AC power system differ from DC?
Why is rectification necessary in avionics systems?

development.content:
AC power generation principles
Transformer operation basics
Rectifier circuit configurations
Filtering components function
Regulation mechanisms

Half-wave vs full-wave rectification
Bridge rectifier topology
Capacitor input filtering
Voltage ripple calculation
Heat dissipation in rectifiers

System integration in aircraft
Failure modes analysis
Maintenance requirements
Safety protocols
Troubleshooting steps

summary_questions: Explain the role of a bridge rectifier in converting AC to DC.
Describe how a capacitor filter reduces voltage ripple in a power supply.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the constructional details of generators and engine coupling to be discussed in LP 02.

pft_rows.syllabus: Generator, engine coupling, cooling of generators, constructional details of brushes types of brushes and causes of brush wear and spark suppression techniques.
